priorityList: Ensure Raise Dead is active at all times.
Cast Outbreak to maintain Virulent Plague if it has fewer than 3 ticks remaining.
Cast Army of the Dead whenever available.
Cast Dark Transformation while Army of the Dead or Horsemen are active, or if Army is on cooldown for more than 30 seconds.
Cast Soul Reaper if the target is below 35% health.
Cast Death Coil if Sudden Doom is active or if you have fewer than 2 Runes available.
Cast Festering Strike if talented into Festering Scythe and the buff/debuff is about to expire (<= 3s).
Cast Scourge Strike if you have at least 1 stack of Lesser Ghoul Ready to summon a Horseman.
Cast Festering Strike if you have 0 stacks of Lesser Ghoul Ready to build toward a summon.
Cast Putrefy if Dark Transformation has more than 12 seconds remaining on its cooldown.
Cast Death Coil to spend Runic Power and avoid capping.
Use offensive Trinkets, Racials, and Potions during Dark Transformation windows.
Request or accept Power Infusion when Dark Transformation or Horsemen are active.
